name: FLA_PAYMENT_TEMPLATE_ACCOUNTS_
description: FLA_PAYMENT_TEMPLATE_ACCOUNTS table is the detail table for FLA_PAYMENT_TEMPLATES_ALL and contains accounting information such as account class and percentage, and so on, for the respective payment term template.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Account detail line identifier. This is primary key for the table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_DETAIL_NUMBER
columns.description: Account detail number. It is a unique number used in the payment template.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier as defined in general ledger.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Row identifier in the GL Code Combinations table associated with this distribution (code_combination_id).

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Account class of the account in this distribution. Values are populated from the lookups, FLA_LEASE_ACCOUNT_CLASS

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_AMOUNT_PERCENT
columns.description: Percentage of the amount from the payment term corresponding to this distribution.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Row identifier in the Payment Terms Template table associated with this distribution.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
